generator_used: OpenAI built-in image_gen with source-backed official Ecowitt and Tempest product compositing
source_method: OpenAI built-in image_gen created the warm residential backyard and oak-workbench background. Exact official Ecowitt GW3001 bundle and Tempest 2026 Weather Station imagery was background-separated and composited onto that generated scene.
post_processing: ImageMagick background separation, crop, proportional scaling, placement, and restrained grounded shadows only. Product shapes and hardware details were not generated or redrawn. No Pillow, deterministic renderer, generic site image, or repeated fallback was used.

visual_review.notes: The full cover and centered crops keep the exact Ecowitt WS90/GW3000 and Tempest sensor recognizable on one practical residential garden workbench. The garden, natural oak, and restrained dark-green shed match Tara's visual direction. There is no headline, poster text, screen, chart, diagram, routing line, translucent panel, inset frame, floating UI card, progress bar, or invented product hardware.
